No separately callable web.run tool was exposed.
limitations: Historical findings, exact factor replications, and proposed H thresholds are distinct; none establish current profitability.

The live SEC page returned HTTP 403. The inspected SEC snapshot is dated 2026-10-29; it is not represented as live content. A subsequent archive retry returned HTTP 429 after a successful decoded retrieval.
The native search/extract backend could not operate; live discovery used fallback providers. A separate web.run tool was not exposed.
Publication and preprint dates are not access dates. Null means no reliable publication date established. Source IDs are local to this ledger.
Open/free research or code does not license market data, establish a point-in-time universe, or prove a predictive edge.
Pinned license inspection is not a full per-file, dependency, patent, trademark or market-data licensing review. No packages installed or implementation code copied.
